name: TC-176: a coupon and a gift card can both be applied to the same order
description: The frontend doesn't gate gift-card redemption on whether a coupon is already applied (or vice versa) — both discounts show simultaneously. This documents currently-supported behavior; it does not touch the separate canCombineWithCoupons config flag, which isn't enforced by either side today (see TEST_COVERAGE.md's Known Technical Debt).
